reason: Clothes in our house get washed by hand, the way it has always been done, and it costs nothing. I can afford ₹22,000, but I don't see why I should spend it on a machine to fix a problem we don't have.
objection: I already have an inverter and battery that keeps the lights and fans going. If I ever bought a washer, I'd first ask whether my inverter can run a plain semi-automatic one, so why pay extra for a second battery inside the machine that only does about 2 loads?
would_change_my_mind: If the dealer showed me in my own house that my inverter can't handle a washer, and that this one doesn't drain my inverter battery in the evening when we need the fans, I might think about it for the women in the house.
